source.title: Certified quantum reachability under local excitation constraints: finite-time envelopes, dissipative all-time bounds, and tensor-rank obstructions
source.note: the classes are the authors’ own; the atlas recomputes some statements (docs/verify-the-dark-diamond.mjs) but replays no Lean proof

LEAN_KERNEL_PASS_SCOPE_REVIEW.meaning: checked by the Lean kernel in the authors’ latest gate, with the scope of the statement under review

LEAN_PASS.meaning: a registered Lean declaration that passes the authors’ controller gate, with only the standard axioms

ANALYTIC_PROOF.meaning: a written proof in the manuscript, not machine-checked

EXACT_COMPUTATION.meaning: an exact (symbolic or rational) computation for the stated case

NUMERIC.meaning: a floating-point computation: evidence, not proof

OPEN.meaning: claimed but not established: the proof or its replay is missing or incomplete

FALSE.meaning: refuted — by a counterexample, an unsound definition, or a failed implication

HISTORICAL.meaning: provenance only: an earlier module or receipt, not evidence by itself

claims.statement: Two-channel Gram determinant is nonnegative under nonnegative weights, with equality iff a weight vanishes or the two channel vectors are collinear.
claims.assumptions: Real weights g,k are nonnegative; finite two-channel Gram expression.
claims.unresolved: Narrow algebraic statement; not a general physical-channel identifiability theorem.

claims.statement: For a finite valid diagonal-channel list, Z=0 iff every channel satisfies rate*(a-b)^2=0.
claims.assumptions: Valid list: every rate nonnegative; actual Channel/X/Y/Z definitions.
claims.unresolved: Physical-time activation still requires the unproved remainder bridge.

claims.statement: If the valid diagonal-channel list is dark (Z=0), the actual exponential probability vanishes at every nonnegative physical time.
claims.assumptions: Valid list; actual probability defined from NormedSpace.exp; t≥0.
claims.unresolved: Included in final 67-name controller gate; converse and positive interval remain open.

claims.statement: The fifth and sixth actual matrix-exponential coefficients recover S=2Z and G=4XY-(X+Y-Z)^2 exactly.
claims.assumptions: Finite diagonal-channel model and the definitions of X,Y,Z; no channel-count inference.
claims.unresolved: Included in final 67-name controller gate. Exact invariant recovery does not prove positivity, rank, or physical identifiability.

claims.statement: For every finite valid diagonal-channel list, the actual effective Gram determinant 4XY-(X+Y-Z)^2 is nonnegative.
claims.assumptions: Finite Channel list with every rate nonnegative; actual X,Y,Z definitions; no equality or channel-count inference.
claims.unresolved: Equality/rank, ancillary CPTP, and physical-time remainder bridges remain open.

claims.statement: For the actual finite diagonal-channel exponential, vanishing at every physical time t>=0 is equivalent to Z=0.
claims.assumptions: Valid finite Channel list; actual NormedSpace.exp probability; real-analytic dependence on t; physical times are the half-line t>=0.
claims.unresolved: Included in the supplied prior 119/119 controller gate; scope is the exact finite diagonal-channel exponential, not arbitrary time-dependent or nonanalytic dynamics.

claims.statement: For the exact finite diagonal-channel GKSL generator, the entrywise sup-norm bound uses K=4+max(X,Y,Z), equivalently 4+max(max(X,Y),Z), under nonnegative rates.
claims.assumptions: Valid finite Channel list; arbitrary complex 4x4 input M; entrywise norm on V=Fin 4 -> Fin 4 -> C; no Hermiticity restriction is needed.
claims.unresolved: Included in the supplied prior 119/119 controller gate; exact finite-product entrywise estimate only.

claims.statement: For the exact finite diagonal-channel exponential, valid nonnegative rates and Z>0 imply p(t)>= (S/60)t^5 on an explicit positive physical-time interval.
claims.assumptions: Valid finite Channel list; Z>0; actual NormedSpace.exp probability; K=4+max(max(X,Y),Z); 0<t<=min(K^-1,Z/K^6); exact-model identity S=2Z.
claims.unresolved: Included in the supplied prior 119/119 controller gate; exact scope and conservative tail constant are part of the theorem hypotheses.

claims.statement: Every globally differentiable solution of the exact finite-product linear ODE with initial state rho0 equals the actual operator-exponential trajectory.
claims.assumptions: Finite Channel list; f:ℝ→V; ∀t, HasDerivAt f (generator cs (f t)) t; f 0=rho0; all-real time domain.
claims.unresolved: Included in the supplied prior 119/119 controller gate; this does not cover a function defined only on t>=0 or a general CPTP/GKSL theorem.

claims.statement: In the exact finite diagonal-channel model, equality of X,Y,Z gives exact observational equivalence for every real time, and physical channel count is not identifiable: one positive channel and two identical positive split channels have identical probability functions but different list lengths.
claims.assumptions: Actual time-independent generator and NormedSpace.exp probability; finite Channel lists; strictly positive rates for the explicit counterexample.
claims.unresolved: Refutes reconstruction of physical list length from this observation/invariant data; effective rank and aggregate invariants remain meaningful, and arbitrary alternative physical models are outside scope.

claims.statement: Ordered words in a switched linear family cannot in general be replaced by a commutative aggregate of modes.
claims.assumptions: Explicit real 2-dimensional linear modes modeA and modeB; no quantum or positivity interpretation is asserted.
claims.unresolved: This is a scope counterexample showing why the correctly stated event quotient must retain ordered words; it does not refute the reachable-quotient theorem under its full hypotheses.

claims.statement: A single event value at one time does not determine a trajectory derivative.
claims.assumptions: Explicit real 2-dimensional states and one linear event readout.
claims.unresolved: This refutes any broader inference from one-time event agreement to full trajectory agreement; it does not challenge the exact exponential/ODE results with their stated initial data.

claims.statement: Equal finite Hilbert-space dimension does not determine generator dynamics.
claims.assumptions: Two explicit 5-dimensional real matrix generators.
claims.unresolved: The trace values 0 and 1 are an exact invariant distinction; this supports the Fibonacci-path/PXP scope warning but does not by itself prove or disprove equivalence of the specific physical models.
